aggregate.derivation: latency = sum of subgraph latency; fps_derived = 1000 / latency (sequential subgraph execution assumption); values from hbdk static estimation, not board measurement

similarity_provenance.method: Original SDK NodeInfo on this exact target BC; CPU backend CLI resumed from the frozen BC
similarity_provenance.comparison_scope: Native full NodeInfo uses one first_cali_data mapping as one verifier input_files entry
similarity_provenance.calibration_count_source: Actual native dataset-count log and frozen tensor manifest
similarity_provenance.note: The backend CLI does not repeat PTQ/NodeInfo; the preserved same-BC original CSV is used. Not dataset accuracy or board inference.

performance_provenance.method: hbdk-cc static latency estimate of the compiled release artifact
performance_provenance.note: Estimates describe the compiled artifact; on-board measurements live in the model benchmark.

derived_metadata.supplements: Actual public HBM IO, native per-output cosine table and observed PTQ dataset count
